SPECTATEMOD-SPECTATING.title: Spectating
SPECTATEMOD-WHAT_GETS_REPLACED.title: What gets replaced
SPECTATEMOD-INDICATORS.title: Indicators
SPECTATEMOD-AUTO_SPECTATE_AFTER_END_TURN: Auto spectate after ending your turn
Automatically switch to a teammate who is still alive and has not ended their turn.
SPECTATEMOD-MANUAL_SPECTATE_ON_CLICK.des: Click a teammate to start or stop spectating them. Click your own character to stop spectating.
SPECTATEMOD-SHOW_SPECTATE_BUTTONS.title: Spectate button in the party list
SPECTATEMOD-SHOW_SPECTATE_BUTTONS.descri: Show an eye next to each player's icon in the top-left party list to start or stop watching them.
SPECTATEMOD-AUTO_SPECTATE_ON_DEATH.title: Auto spectate when you die
SPECTATEMOD-AUTO_SPECTATE_ON_DEATH.descr: Start watching a teammate as soon as you die. Prefers someone still taking their turn, but will settle for any teammate who is alive.
SPECTATEMOD-PREFERRED_TEAMMATE_SLOT.desc: Teammate to prefer for auto spectate. 0 picks the first eligible teammate. If the preferred teammate is dead or has ended their turn, another eligible teammate is used.
SPECTATEMOD-SHOW_HAND_PEEK_BAR.title: Peek boxes under End Turn
SPECTATEMOD-SHOW_HAND_PEEK_BAR.descripti: Show a small box per player under the End Turn button. Rest the mouse on one for a moment to see that player's hand, and what they do with it, until you move away.
SPECTATEMOD-PEEK_HOVER_DELAY.title: Peek hover delay
SPECTATEMOD-PEEK_HOVER_DELAY.description: How long, in seconds, the mouse has to rest on a peek box before its hand is shown. 0 shows it immediately.
SPECTATEMOD-REPLACE_HAND.title: Replace your hand
SPECTATEMOD-REPLACE_HAND.description: Show the spectated teammate's hand in place of your own.
SPECTATEMOD-REPLACE_COMBAT_UI.title: Replace combat UI
SPECTATEMOD-REPLACE_COMBAT_UI.descriptio: Point the draw, discard and exhaust piles, the energy orb and the star counter at the teammate you are watching.
SPECTATEMOD-REPLACE_RELICS.title: Replace relics
SPECTATEMOD-REPLACE_RELICS.description: Show the spectated teammate's relics in the top bar instead of your own.
SPECTATEMOD-MIRROR_HOVER.title: Mirror card hover
SPECTATEMOD-MIRROR_HOVER.description: Raise the card the teammate is inspecting.
SPECTATEMOD-INSPECT_TEAMMATE_CARDS.title: Inspect their cards with your mouse
SPECTATEMOD-INSPECT_TEAMMATE_CARDS.descr: Point at a card in the spectated hand to lift it and read it, whatever the teammate is doing.
SPECTATEMOD-SHOW_CARD_PLAY_VISUALS.title: Show card play and targeting
SPECTATEMOD-SHOW_CARD_PLAY_VISUALS.descr: Draw the teammate's targeting arrow and selection reticle in your own view.
SPECTATEMOD-SHOW_SPECTATING_LABEL.title: Show "Spectating" label
SPECTATEMOD-SHOW_SPECTATING_LABEL.descri: Show the name of the player you are watching at the top of the screen.
SPECTATEMOD-SHOW_SPECTATING_BORDER.title: Show red screen border
SPECTATEMOD-SHOW_SPECTATING_BORDER.descr: Outline the screen in red while spectating.
SPECTATEMOD-SHOW_OWN_ENERGY.title: Show your own energy
SPECTATEMOD-SHOW_OWN_ENERGY.description: While the combat UI shows a teammate's energy, keep a smaller orb with yours beside it.
